Container.Name: WARHOST
Container.Overview:
WARHOST runs Eugen's official WARNO dedicated server and writes login.ini, variables.ini, and params_for_ai.json from this form.
WARNO was a game made in France, but WARHOST was created in the United States.
Request a login and key from eugsupport@eugensystems.com (one pair runs five servers); the preset is Jungle Law 2v2, map and mod IDs are in the project README, and the game port must be forwarded to this Unraid server as TCP and UDP.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: WARNO WARNO server dedicated server game server mods modded
Container.Requires: An Eugen Systems WARNO dedicated-server login and key for the person hosting. Joining players need the game and, for Jungle Law, Steam Workshop item 3811913066.

Config.Name: Settings Folder
Config.Description: Folder for this server's settings. Use a different folder for each container.

Config.Name: Eugen Login
Config.Description: Login from Eugen's reply, exactly as written. Not your Steam name; this login and the key are a matching pair good for five containers.

Config.Name: Eugen Dedicated Key
Config.Description: Key from the same reply. Shown in clear text on this form so servers can be told apart.

Config.Name: Public WAN IP
Config.Description: Public address players connect to. Not a hostname, and not this Unraid server's LAN address.

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: Port players use. Forward it to this Unraid host as TCP and UDP; each container needs its own free port.

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Name players see in the WARNO browser. Do not use an equals sign.

Config.Name: Max Players
Config.Description: Total slots, both sides. Preset 4, maximum 20, not locked to the map; 8 on a 2v2 map is untested.

Config.Name: Minimum Players
Config.Description: Players needed before the countdown starts. Cannot be higher than Max Players.

Config.Name: Team Size
Config.Description: Slots on one side. Preset 2, usually half of Max Players.

Config.Name: Combat Rule
Config.Description: 1 is Destruction and 2 is Conquest. Match DEST or CONQ in the scenario ID.

Config.Name: Write Config From Form
Config.Description: true rewrites the three settings files from this form on every start.

Config.Name: Workshop Mod Tags
Config.Description: Browser icons only. Words are Gameplay, Interface, Maps, Scenarios, Music, and Sound, joined with hyphens.

Config.Name: Workshop Mod List
Config.Description: 3811913066/15 is the WARNO: Red Dragon - Map Pack, and 15 is that pack's version for Workshop Mod List. workshopId/version comes from the mod's Config.ini; clear it for a base-game map, and see the project README for named mods.

Config.Name: Map
Config.Description: Scenario ID, not the display name. Preset RDPort_JungleLaw_2v2_CONQ; base-game and workshop lists are in the project README.
